entries.title: Job 23:2
segments: Even to-day is my complaint rebellious: My stroke is heavier than my groaning.

entries.title: Job 23:3
segments: Oh that I knew where I might find him! That I might come even to his seat!

entries.title: Job 23:4
segments: I would set my cause in order before him, And fill my mouth with arguments.

entries.title: Job 23:5
segments: I would know the words which he would answer me, And understand what he would say unto me.

entries.title: Job 23:6
segments: Would he contend with me in the greatness of his power? Nay; but he would give heed unto me.

entries.title: Job 23:7
segments: There the upright might reason with him; So should I be delivered for ever from my judge.

entries.title: Job 23:8
segments: Behold, I go forward, but he is not [there]; And backward, but I cannot perceive him;

entries.title: Job 23:9
segments: On the left hand, when he doth work, but I cannot behold him; He hideth himself on the right hand, that I cannot see him.

entries.title: Job 23:10
segments: But he knoweth the way that I take; When he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.

entries.title: Job 23:11
segments: My foot hath held fast to his steps; His way have I kept, and turned not aside.

entries.title: Job 23:12
segments: I have not gone back from the commandment of his lips; I have treasured up the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.

entries.title: Job 23:13
segments: But he is in one [mind], and who can turn him? And what his soul desireth, even that he doeth.

entries.title: Job 23:14
segments: For he performeth that which is appointed for me: And many such things are with him.

entries.title: Job 23:15
segments: Therefore am I terrified at his presence; When I consider, I am afraid of him.

entries.title: Job 23:16
segments: For God hath made my heart faint, And the Almighty hath terrified me;

entries.title: Job 23:17
segments: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, Neither did he cover the thick darkness from my face.
